content: "Dating a convicted sex offender means accepting their past—no matter how much they’ve ‘changed.’ Trust is fragile, safety is non-negotiable, and the risk of harm (to you or others) isn’t worth the gamble. Love shouldn’t require ignoring red flags or sacrificing peace of mind."
